description: Check whether an agent is set up to act for your profile, and what it may currently do. Given agentWallet (plus agentId when one account hosts several), it reports linked:true with the identity proof and active delegation, or link_required with the one next step. It does not create, change, or remove anything; to grant or change authority, use proofable_verify with agent-delegation.

agentId.description: Stable agent id. Required when one account hosts more than one agent.

agentWallet.description: Agent account. Required. Pass agentId when one account hosts more than one agent.

identityQHash.description: Identity proof ID the agent just signed (returned by proofable_verify). Lets the owner link an identity no grant names yet.

principal.description: Optional owner account or DID. Omit when the signed-in profile is the owner.

name: proofable_agent_link
title: Check agent permissions
